manual_verification.general_comment: Shared review tracker: the user performs the manual checks, and Codex records the results and any follow-up notes in the task workflow. Branch-level review evidence recorded on 2026-03-28: user manually executed the backend automated test suite and reported `131 passed in 4.74s` from `clinic-ai-assistant-src/backend`.

categories.name: Category 1 - Booking And Scheduling UX Guardrails

tests.name: Test 1.1 - Booking configuration failure stays user-safe
tests.purpose: Confirm scheduling configuration failure paths do not leak raw internal exception text into user-facing booking responses.

rows.action: Open a booking flow or sandbox path that exercises scheduling booking behavior.
rows.what_is_tested: The reviewer is on a surface where the booking error path can be observed.

rows.action: Trigger the known booking-configuration failure path if your environment can reproduce it, or review the equivalent user-facing failure response from a controlled test path.
rows.what_is_tested: The user-facing message remains bounded and does not expose raw internal exception wording.

tests.name: Test 1.2 - Normal scheduling flow still completes
tests.purpose: Confirm the standard scheduling-first user flow still behaves normally after the static-analysis cleanup.

rows.action: Open the main booking or scheduling surface and request available appointment times.
rows.what_is_tested: The normal slot-discovery flow still starts correctly.

rows.action: Select a valid slot and continue through the next booking step that is available in your environment.
rows.what_is_tested: Slot selection and follow-through still work without regression.

categories.name: Category 2 - Chat And Route Surface Stability

tests.name: Test 2.1 - Main chat still responds normally
tests.purpose: Confirm route-layer exception-chaining cleanup did not alter standard chat behavior.

rows.action: Open the main chat surface for a normal tenant and send a basic non-error message.
rows.what_is_tested: The chat route still returns a normal response for standard interaction.

rows.action: If you have a safe repro path for a handled chat error, trigger it and inspect the returned result.
rows.what_is_tested: Handled route errors keep their expected message and status behavior after explicit exception chaining.

tests.name: Test 2.2 - Scheduling route error handling still returns expected status and message shape
tests.purpose: Confirm the scheduling routes preserve their existing API behavior after the `B904` fixes.

rows.action: Exercise a normal scheduling request and then a known handled error case on the scheduling route if available.
rows.what_is_tested: The route still preserves the expected success and handled-error response shape.

tests.name: Test 3.1 - Valid tenant slug still loads
tests.purpose: Confirm valid tenant slugs still load the expected profile after config-loader hardening.

rows.action: Open a known valid tenant path such as a standard tenant-specific page or request path used in your environment.
rows.what_is_tested: A normal valid tenant slug still resolves successfully.

tests.name: Test 3.2 - Invalid traversal-style tenant input is rejected safely
tests.purpose: Confirm traversal-style tenant input is blocked at the boundary instead of being treated as a profile path.

rows.action: Attempt a safe non-destructive invalid tenant value that resembles path traversal, such as `../bad-tenant`, through a tenant-based route or request path if you have a local repro surface for it.
rows.what_is_tested: Invalid traversal-style tenant input is rejected cleanly and does not load a profile.
